intro: This tag archive collects 43 ZCyberNews articles on Microsoft published between 2026-04-12 and 2026-10-14. Coverage spans 22 high, 7 critical, 10 medium, 3 informational, and 1 low severity items. Reported activity involves Secret Blizzard, Star Blizzard, and Storm-2755. Prominent vulnerabilities include CVE-2026-41089 at CVSS 9.8, CVE-2026-21643 and CVE-2026-40372 at CVSS 9.1, and CVE-2026-108398 and CVE-2026-92707 at CVSS 8.8. Affected sectors include enterprise, government, multiple, technology, and critical infrastructure, with reporting touching Global, Ukraine, United states, Asia, and Canada.
